title: Log in to the extension
intro: With your session, the Decatron extension can recognize you in live translation. This login only serves that purpose: it does not give access to your dashboard.
needLogin: First log in with your account.
ok: Done, {{login}}: the extension now has your session. You can close this tab.
noext: I did not detect the extension. Install (or enable) it in this browser and press Retry.
error: The login could not be completed. Try again.
revokeHint: If you lost a browser or want to start over, you can log out of the extension in all your browsers.
revoked: Done: browsers with the previous session no longer recognize you.
